reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, the complete unchanged raw RGB output, the complete white/cyan/alpha sheet and the unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The frontal composition, tight serious mouth, dark separate brows under the visor and short covered temple hair remain. The grey-green peaked cap has the dark band, gold cord, lower wreath and upper bird groups. The grey-green tunic keeps red gold-leaf collar patches and central red piping. A compact rounded chin sits close to the fitted collar with no long yellow neck, floating cloth or cream bib. Full pale backing and chest-up crop are retained without an invented beard or changed face direction.
entries.alpha_decision: Both source and raw are fully opaque. Full white/cyan inspection shows no holes, missing backing or transparent clothing. No alpha derivation was needed or performed.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact badge relief and fine hair strands are pixel-limited at 156x210; no unsupported fine-detail match is claimed. This DLC source remains distinct from the base land_7 asset with a different source SHA.
